info.name: Support Ticket Management System
info.description:
1. Run the seed script (python scripts/seed_demo.py).
2. Run one of the 'Login' requests in the Auth folder; it stores the token.
3. Call any endpoint. To test another role, log in as that role first.

Live notifications use a WebSocket: ws://localhost:8000/ws/notifications?token=<access_token>

request.description: Public sign-up. The role is always 'customer'.
Logs in as the seeded admin and stores the tokens in collection variables.
Logs in as the seeded agent and stores the tokens in collection variables.
Logs in as the seeded customer and stores the tokens in collection variables.
Each refresh token works once; a new pair is returned.
Signs the user out everywhere. Use your own values, this changes the password.
Filtering by role=agent also stores the first agent's id in {{agent_id}}.
priority_name: low | medium | high | critical. Due date is set from the priority's SLA.
Tick the checkboxes to enable filters. Results are scoped by role.
Accepts the same filters as the list. Downloads a .csv.
Changing the priority recalculates the due date.
open -> in_progress -> resolved -> closed. Resolved can be reopened to in_progress.
